== Usage ==
{{ItemInfo
|type = Sword

|rarity = r
|damage = 68

|strength = 36
|special_effect = Reduced the cooldown of Guided Sheep by {{Gold|5}} seconds, and prevents Guided Sheep from spawning randomly while holding this item.
}}
The '''Conjuring''', being a sword, can be used as a melee weapon: while in the [[Catacombs]], it reduces the cooldown of {{AN|Guided Sheep}} by {{Green|5s}} and prevents them from spawning randomly.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Conjuring''' was implemented upon the release of the [[Catacombs]], but wasn't obtainable up until [[Changelog/2021/March 9|Update 0.11.2]].
*Attempting to use the {{AN|Guided Sheep}} ability outside of the [[Catacombs]] displays the following message: {{Dialogue|&cThis ability can only be used inside dungeons!}}
